name: llama.cpp Discussion #15013 — Performance of llama.cpp on Nvidia CUDA (community scoreboard)
notes: Curated maintainer-verified community scoreboard for llama.cpp CUDA backend: llama-2-7b.Q4_0, pp512/tg128, each row carries a build commit + named reporter. The canonical cross-GPU llama-bench comparison table. Re-read 2026-10-16: the FA-on table now also carries RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell tg128 (168.90, build becc481, @Hedede), RTX 4090 D (pp512 12506.97 / tg128 191.57, build 79c1160, @autonomous-ai-lab), RTX 5090 Laptop (pp512 7641.89 / tg128 158.14, build 29f1482, @rs38), Quadro RTX 6000 (pp512 2941.85 / tg128 93.11, build 1e74897, @Hedede) and Quadro RTX 8000 (pp512 2934.33 / tg128 91.88, build 79c1160, @Hedede). The 5090 Laptop row prints a 384-bit bus that the spec sheet does not support.
